priv_b.en: Your video never leaves your device.
priv_b.es: Tu video nunca sale de tu dispositivo.

priv_p.en: It isn't uploaded or evaluated. We only save a thumbnail as proof that you recorded it.
priv_p.es: No se sube ni se evalúa. Solo guardamos una miniatura como prueba de que lo grabaste.

hero.intro_en: Record a 1-minute pitch about your career goals, as if a recruiter asked you: “Where do you see your career going?” Use your resume draft from Writing as a base and practice clarity, tone and confidence.
hero.intro_es: Graba un pitch de 1 minuto sobre tus metas profesionales, como si una reclutadora te preguntara: “Where do you see your career going?”. Usa el borrador de tu currículum de Writing como base y practica claridad, tono y seguridad.

must.en: Who you are and your current or last role
must.es: Quién eres y tu puesto actual o último

must.en: Your strongest experience or result, with a number
must.es: Tu experiencia o resultado más fuerte, con un número

must.en: The role you want next in the U.S.
must.es: El puesto que quieres en EE. UU.

must.en: Why you're a good fit, and a confident close
must.es: Por qué eres buena opción y un cierre seguro

tips.desc_es: Usa la cámara de tu teléfono, de lado.

tips.desc_en: Check your mic before you record.
tips.desc_es: Revisa tu micrófono antes de grabar.

tips.desc_en: Face a window or a lamp.
tips.desc_es: Ponte frente a una ventana o lámpara.

tips.desc_en: It doesn't need to be formal.
As if talking to a real person.
tips.desc_es: Como si hablaras con una persona real.

en: Slow down when you say your key result.
Back straight, look at the camera.
End with the role you want next.
es: Habla más despacio al decir tu resultado clave.
Espalda recta, mira a la cámara.
Termina con el puesto que quieres.

Title: Your 1-Minute Career Pitch
Estimated Time: 1 Hour
Goal: Record a 1-minute pitch about your career goals, clearly and with confidence.

Syllabus line (Week 4):
Week 4 – Human Resources & Hiring
The hiring process, onboarding, employee benefits
Capstone Part 4: Your work history in resume form
Reading: Sample resumes and job ads
Writing: First draft of your U.S.-style resume
Speaking: 1-minute pitch about your career goals

Instructions (CelsU, from the syllabus line “Speaking: 1-minute pitch about your career goals”):
Use your resume draft as a base. In about 1 minute, say who you are, your strongest experience or result, the role you want next in the U.S., and why you are a good fit.
